//: Permissions shared by every checkout of this repository, so a fresh
machine or account is not prompted for the read-only and rebuild-only
commands this project runs constantly. Machine-specific settings go in
.claude/settings.local.json, which .gitignore keeps out of the repo.
THIS IS NOT A COPY OF THAT FILE. Fifteen of these rules were never in
it, and three that were are scoped down here, because a rule that one
person accepted for one machine is a different thing from a standing
grant to every account that clones the repository.
The test for entry: the command changes nothing, or changes only a
generated artefact that `make all` would rewrite anyway. Anything that
writes to the remote, to history, or to repository settings is absent
and stays a prompt — git commit, push, pull, gh pr merge, and `gh api`
with a method. Read-only `gh api` is not listed either, because the
rule cannot distinguish it from a PUT to branch protection.
Prefix matching does not constrain later flags, which is why several
obvious-looking rules are absent or scoped. `ruff check` is pinned to
--no-fix because --fix rewrites modules under data/, and a build input
edited without review changes f1.db. `git branch` is --list only
because `git branch -f` moves a ref and loses history. `git remote` is
read-only because set-url redirects every later fetch and push. find
and `sed -n` are absent: `find -delete`, `find -exec` and a later -i
all match a prefix that looks read-only. npm ci and a bare npm run are
absent too — npm ci runs every dependency's install scripts, and
npm run dev/preview start servers that never exit, which is the stale
listener docs/AGENT-NOTES.md warns about.
